157.news_title: Arcooda Monitors to Premier at the Australasian Gaming Expo (AGE)
157.long_description: We are making our world release of our 29inch 4:3 1600x1200, and our 35inch 4:3 2880x2160 Arcooda monitors at the Australasian Gaming Expo (AGE) which starts on the 12th August 2025. Our monitors not only support all PC models, they also support 15khz and other RGB video signals. At the show we will be exhibiting; - 16.6inch Arcooda LCD Marquee monitor, suitable for media display, arcade header, and many other options. It will be displayed with its Vewlix/Xtreme brackets. - 29inch Arcooda 4:3 ratio 1600x1200 LCD monitor, with its metal frame mounted via VESA, and also showing the mounting angle brackets. Photos shown are of our 29inch with metal mounting brackets. - 35inch Arcooda UHD 4:3 ratio 2660x2160 LCD monitor, with its metal frame mounted via VESA, and also showing the mounting angle brackets. Show details; Australasian Gaming Expo 12-14 August, 2025 ICC Sydney We will be on booth 830, looking forward to meeting with you.
